import pandas as pd

items = pd.read_csv("order_items.csv")
orders = pd.read_csv("orders.csv", parse_dates=["order_date"])
items["revenue"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"] * (1 - items["discount"])
order_revenue = items.groupby("order_id", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum()
orders = orders.merge(order_revenue, on="order_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
orders = orders[orders["status"] != "cancelled"]

by_time = orders.set_index("order_date")
monthly = by_time.resample("ME")["revenue"].sum()
monthly_orders = by_time.resample("ME")["order_id"].count()

quarterly = by_time.resample("QE")["revenue"].sum()
yoy = quarterly.pct_change(4)

best_weekday = orders.groupby(orders["order_date"].dt.day_name())["revenue"].sum().idxmax()
print(yoy.round(3))

isinstance(quarterly, pd.Series) and len(quarterly) == 8 and abs(float(quarterly.iloc[-1]) - 146825.44) < 1
isinstance(yoy, pd.Series) and round(float(yoy.iloc[-1]), 3) == 1.795 and yoy.iloc[:4].isna().all()
